exposed_options.name: Convert Z- to Y-Up
exposed_options.description:
Turns rotation to z-axis pointing upwards on/off. Helpful if origin axis system is Z-Up and target system is Y-Up.

![convert-z-up-to-y-up](import/00-cad_import/convert-z-up-to-y-up.webp)

exposed_options.name: FBX Normal Map Y Flip
exposed_options.description:
Inverts the green channel of all normal maps on import.
If the bump maps look indented instead of out-dented, this option can help fix them. DirectX uses the Y-down convention, while glTF uses the Y-up convention.
Only affects FBX data.

![fbx-normal-map-y-flip](import/00-cad_import/fbx-normal-map-y-flip.webp)

exposed_options.name: USD Profile
exposed_options.description:
Defines how input USD files are interpreted.
***generic***: When in doubt, choose this option.
***arkit***: If a USD is known to be setup for ARKit, use this option. Assets targeted at the initial USDZ implementation in ARKit operate under greater constraints than USDZ files for more general 'in house' uses, and this option ensures the scene is parsed accurately.

![fbx-normal-map-y-flip](import/00-cad_import/usd-usdz-arkit.webp)

exposed_options.name: USD Purpose
exposed_options.description: >Defines the purpose of rendering a prim, used to control render visibility and classify prims into visibility categories. The default string is ***render***, but this can be replaced with another string as needed.

exposed_options.name: USD Convert Display Colors
exposed_options.description: How to convert USD display colors, either into material colors or into vertex colors.

exposed_options.name: Discard Cameras
exposed_options.description: If set, discards any cameras on import.

exposed_options.name: Discard Lights
exposed_options.description: If set, discards any lights on import. Currently only glTF point lights are supported.

exposed_options.name: Discard Animations
exposed_options.description: If set, discards any animations on import.

exposed_options.name: Discard Morph Targets
exposed_options.description: If set, discards any morph targets (blend shapes) on import.

exposed_options.name: Discard unused UVs
exposed_options.description: If set, discards any unused UVs on import. Unused UVs are defined as UVs not associated with any texture map.
